captions.detailed: A scale passenger sightseeing blimp with a long, streamlined light gray envelope hull. Suspended underneath is a rectangular passenger cabin (gondola) with dark blue window bands, featuring a small support fork holding a single black mooring wheel at the rear. On each side of the cabin, a small engine pod supports a three-bladed black propeller. The tail section consists of a cruciform fin arrangement with a vertical rudder and horizontal elevators.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated sightseeing blimp. It must feature a streamlined main envelope, an underslung passenger cabin with a small rear mooring wheel, side-mounted propeller pods, and a cruciform tail assembly. Define joints to allow the propellers and mooring wheel to rotate continuously, and the rudder and elevators to pivot on their respective axes.
captions.factory: Construct the main envelope by lofting or revolving a streamlined profile into an elongated ellipsoid. Build the rectangular passenger cabin underneath using basic box primitives, and attach a rear support fork and wheel. Model the cruciform tail fins using extruded sketches, separating the rudder and elevators into distinct parts connected via revolute joints. Create the left and right propeller assemblies with three-bladed hubs, mounting them on the sides of the gondola using continuous rotation joints.
